facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.justification: MOC-2016-0084 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 10 July 2016 as a scheduled change under management of change; no event precedes it in the record. The management of change record carries no clause change; it records the assessment only. The intent is to strengthen the critical control named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state merged in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical control set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are ALERT-2009-003, PRO-MEC-055 and STD-LFT-003.
